spec.title: RepliSense QC Operations
spec.description: Live health at the top; activity uses the selected period. Counts are telemetry estimates, not quotas or database totals. Missing data is never treated as healthy.

panels.title: At a glance — live health and activity in the selected period
Customer access
panels.description: Live website HTTPS and API reachability; both checks must report and pass. API expects 401 without login. This is not an end-to-end evaluation test.

targets.expr: min by(environment) (probe_success{environment=~"$environment",service=~"frontend|api-edge"}) * on(environment) (count by(environment) (probe_success{environment=~"$environment",service=~"frontend|api-edge"}) == bool 2) * on(environment) (max by(environment) (time() - timestamp(probe_success{environment=~"$environment",service=~"frontend|api-edge"})) < bool 180)

panels.title: QC processing health
panels.description: Live API, worker, Python, database/cache and document-engine readiness plus a heartbeat younger than two minutes. Healthy means reachable, not guaranteed job success.

targets.expr: min by(environment) (up{environment=~"$environment",job=~"replisense-(node-api|qc-worker|python-gateway)"}) * on(environment) (count by(environment) (up{environment=~"$environment",job=~"replisense-(node-api|qc-worker|python-gateway)"}) == bool 3) * on(environment) min by(environment) (probe_success{environment=~"$environment",service=~"node-dependencies|document-engine|redis"}) * on(environment) (count by(environment) (probe_success{environment=~"$environment",service=~"node-dependencies|document-engine|redis"}) == bool 3) * on(environment) (max by(environment) (time() - replisense_worker_heartbeat_timestamp_seconds{environment=~"$environment",worker="qc-worker"}) < bool 120)

panels.title: Monitoring coverage
panels.description: All four expected private metric targets must report successfully within three minutes. Missing telemetry is Not reporting, never Healthy. Health is current, not historical uptime.

targets.expr: min by(environment) (up{environment=~"$environment",job=~"replisense-(node-api|qc-worker|python-gateway|host)"}) * on(environment) (count by(environment) (up{environment=~"$environment",job=~"replisense-(node-api|qc-worker|python-gateway|host)"}) == bool 4) * on(environment) (max by(environment) (time() - timestamp(up{environment=~"$environment",job=~"replisense-(node-api|qc-worker|python-gateway|host)"})) < bool 180)

panels.title: Reviews completed
panels.description: Estimated sampled counter increase in the selected period; not database totals, unique documents or contract quota. Collection gaps/restarts can undercount.

targets.expr: (sum by(environment) (increase(replisense_qc_runs_total{environment=~"$environment",status="completed"}[$__range]))) or on(environment) ((0 * (min by(environment) (up{environment=~"$environment",job="replisense-qc-worker"}) == 1)) and on(environment) (max by(environment) (time() - timestamp(up{environment=~"$environment",job="replisense-qc-worker"})) < 180))

panels.title: Reviewed DOCX generated
panels.description: Estimated sampled counter increase in the selected period; not database totals, unique documents or contract quota. Collection gaps/restarts can undercount. Generated exports are not downloads.

targets.expr: (sum by(environment) (increase(replisense_qc_exports_total{environment=~"$environment",outcome="completed"}[$__range]))) or on(environment) ((0 * (min by(environment) (up{environment=~"$environment",job="replisense-qc-worker"}) == 1)) and on(environment) (max by(environment) (time() - timestamp(up{environment=~"$environment",job="replisense-qc-worker"})) < 180))

panels.title: Processing attempts failed
panels.description: Estimated sampled counter increase in the selected period; not database totals, unique documents or contract quota. Collection gaps/restarts can undercount. Retries can succeed later; not a count of permanently failed documents.

targets.expr: (sum by(environment) (increase(replisense_worker_jobs_failed_total{environment=~"$environment",worker="qc-worker"}[$__range]))) or on(environment) ((0 * (min by(environment) (up{environment=~"$environment",job="replisense-qc-worker"}) == 1)) and on(environment) (max by(environment) (time() - timestamp(up{environment=~"$environment",job="replisense-qc-worker"})) < 180))

panels.title: API server errors
panels.description: HTTP 5xx responses in the selected period. Zero only while fresh API metrics report; missing telemetry stays unknown.

targets.expr: (sum by(environment) (increase(replisense_http_requests_total{environment=~"$environment",service="node-api",status_code=~"5.."}[$__range]))) or on(environment) ((0 * (min by(environment) (up{environment=~"$environment",job="replisense-node-api"}) == 1)) and on(environment) (max by(environment) (time() - timestamp(up{environment=~"$environment",job="replisense-node-api"})) < 180))

panels.title: Needs attention — current alerts
panels.description: Current firing, pending, recovery and evaluation-error alerts. An empty list means no matching alerts, not proof of end-to-end health. Document findings are not monitoring incidents.

panels.title: Availability history
panels.description: Historical checks, not request traces or guaranteed QC success. Green = passing, red = failing, gaps = no observation. Never connect gaps into a healthy interval.

panels.title: Review speed distribution
panels.description: Measured worker attempts by duration bucket and time; excludes queue waiting/export. Five-minute sampled histogram increases are estimates, not exact document counts. Empty intervals mean no measured attempts. Durations over one hour are outside the finite buckets.

panels.title: Findings identified · rolling hour
panels.description: Requires worker metrics. Findings are not application incidents.

panels.title: Failed processing attempts · rolling hour
panels.description: Failed engine attempts; retries may later succeed. Private worker endpoint required.

targets.expr: (sum by(environment) (increase(replisense_worker_jobs_failed_total{environment=~"$environment",worker="qc-worker"}[1h]))) or on(environment) ((0 * (min by(environment) (up{environment=~"$environment",job="replisense-qc-worker"}) == 1)) and on(environment) (max by(environment) (time() - timestamp(up{environment=~"$environment",job="replisense-qc-worker"})) < 180))

panels.title: Application requests
panels.description: Requests per second, excluding health/readiness checks. Includes API polling, not a count of users or documents.

panels.title: Response time · 95th percentile
panels.description: Includes document uploads/processing; not an interactive API-only SLO.

targets.expr: (sum by(environment) (increase(replisense_http_requests_total{environment=~"$environment",status_code=~"5.."}[10m]))) or on(environment) ((0 * (min by(environment) (up{environment=~"$environment",job="replisense-node-api"}) == 1)) and on(environment) (max by(environment) (time() - timestamp(up{environment=~"$environment",job="replisense-node-api"})) < 180))

panels.title: AI usage — application activity, not a provider bill
AI provider calls / hour
panels.description: Application provider calls, including repeated calls. SDK-internal retries are not counted separately.

panels.title: AI reported tokens / hour
panels.description: Provider-reported input/output usage, not a billing estimate. Overlapping total/cache counts are omitted. Zero-only providers are hidden; other applications sharing credentials are not visible here.

panels.title: Technical details — dependencies, capacity and certificates
QC dependency overview

panels.title: Metrics collection
panels.description: Missing series means not configured, NOT healthy. QC internal metrics need an outbound collector or private tunnel.

panels.title: TLS expiry (days)
panels.description: Public website/API certificate days remaining. Warning below 30 days, critical below 14. This is not the private origin certificate.

panels.title: Worker heartbeat age
panels.description: Unavailable until worker metrics exposure is implemented; missing data is not a healthy heartbeat.

panels.title: Server CPU usage
panels.description: Aggregate QC host CPU; no Docker socket or privileged exporter is used.

panels.title: Sanitized operational events
panels.description: Only allowlisted event names, never document text, filenames, client identities, prompts or credentials.

panels.title: Telemetry freshness
panels.description: Age of the oldest visible API/worker/Python/host scrape sample. Below three minutes is fresh. A missing target is also detected by Monitoring coverage; no series means unknown, not fresh.
